categories.main_business_segments: Wuxi Online Offline Communication Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: mobile information services and digital marketing services. The mobile information services segment focuses on providing enterprise SMS, international SMS, video SMS, 5G messaging, voice SMS, and one-click login services. The digital marketing segment offers advertising media agency, creative planning, short video production, brand planning, influencer collaboration, and account operation services on major media platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technology platforms built on data grids and service grids to ensure high-volume, stable, and secure SMS transmission. It integrates big data analytics, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and container orchestration technologies to develop its enterprise communication management platform and cloud-based messaging services. The company also employs rigorous content auditing systems and real-time visual data analytics to optimize message delivery and customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include enterprises in finance, internet, e-commerce, express logistics, insurance, education, freight, home decoration, and travel sectors. The company serves both direct customers (non-SMS or digital marketing businesses) and channel customers (mobile information service providers or digital marketing businesses). It also targets domestic companies expanding overseas with international SMS services. The digital marketing business focuses on advertising clients on platforms like ByteDance's TikTok, Toutiao, Xigua Video, and Tencent Ads.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with 99.68% of revenue generated domestically. It has established cooperation with telecom operators across multiple provinces and cities in China. Additionally, it is expanding its international SMS business to serve Chinese enterprises with overseas operations. The company has subsidiaries and operational bases in cities including Wuxi, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Beijing, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the mobile information service supply chain. It procures SMS resources directly from telecom operators (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom) and third-party suppliers, then provides integrated messaging platforms and marketing services to enterprise customers. In digital marketing, it acts as an intermediary between advertisers and media platforms, managing media resource procurement and campaign execution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on strengthening its core mobile information services while expanding digital marketing capabilities. It invests in R&D projects involving big data, AI, cloud computing, 5G messaging, and communication platform synchronization to enhance service scalability, security, and innovation. The company aims to deepen financial sector client penetration, broaden international SMS offerings, and explore new digital marketing formats such as short dramas and mini-program platforms. Talent development and governance improvements are also key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of mobile information services, including SMS transmission fees and customized software service fees. Digital marketing revenue comes from service fees for marketing strategy, content creation, media account management, and advertising media resource resale margins. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns on financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading mobile information service provider in China with a strong presence in the digital marketing sector. It competes with other telecom service aggregators and digital advertising agencies. Its competitive advantages include direct partnerships with major telecom operators, proprietary technology platforms, and established relationships with top internet media platforms. The company leverages its integrated service offerings to differentiate itself in a competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.635 billion, a 15.58% decrease from 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 26.39 million, down 47.35% year-over-year. The mobile information services segment accounted for 61.72% of revenue, while digital marketing contributed 36.20%. Despite revenue declines due to industry fluctuations and client demand contraction, the company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 1.333 billion and continues investing in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology-driven, secure, and efficient mobile information services with comprehensive platform capabilities supporting diverse messaging formats including 5G messages. It offers tailored solutions with real-time monitoring and data analytics to optimize client messaging strategies. In digital marketing, it provides end-to-end services from strategy to execution on leading media platforms, enhancing advertising effectiveness. Its integrated service model, strong telecom and media partnerships, and customer-centric approach create differentiated value and foster long-term client relationships.
